run.display_title: Reuse CI compiler caches and preserve qualified analysis execution

head_commit.message:
Preserve signed analysis policy with an ordinary CI adapter

Introduced by: 14595cf8 shared analysis execution by changing two files bound
into the published noble-qt693-analysis verification policy.
Use case: Ordinary static, coverage and CodeQL jobs must keep consuming the
existing qualified environment without fabricated replacement evidence.
Reproduction: The six-family compatibility test fails only for the analysis
family, and the real consumer rejects its current qualification-policy digest.

Restore the qualified engine and shell entry point to their approved bytes.
Route ordinary static/coverage phases through a separate adapter that imports
the unchanged engine's configuration, environment, execution, first-party
filtering and cppcheck primitives. Preserve changed-only PR scope, independent
failure propagation, coverage transport and the original-checkout ratchet.

The immutable engine has no phase API, so document partial reuse honestly and
protect remaining ordinary orchestration with command-parity tests. Production
locks, profiles, signed receipts and their verification are unchanged.

Verification: 47 qualification/adapter tests, 22 profile tests, 33 static
regressions, 16 executable namespace/failure tests and 11 focused lint tests
passed. All six production policies match again. CI lint, affected-workflow
actionlint and whitespace checks passed. The complete integrated quality gate
will run before push; remote/native analysis was not executed locally.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
